title: A first kbgit.py publish refuses official GUIDs and doc-example addresses that the tracked-file leak scan accepts
goal: publish's leak scan accepts what the tracked-file leak test in test_kb.py accepts (the same allow rules for official ids and documentation example values in kb roots), so a first publish of a clone whose history holds official AD schema GUIDs or example IPs from vendor docs does not refuse them; test_publish_scan_matches_tracked_scan in _tools/test_kbpublic.py plants one such value in a kb root; found while fixing BG-rqgmjrq3 (45 causes on a first publish of main, 23 before that fix)
